`django/template/loader_tags.py`

It works like this. `BlockNode.render` (line 51) checks `render_context` for a `BlockContext`. `BlockContext` (line 14) holds a FIFO stack of override blocks per name, built by `ExtendsNode.render` (line 134), which adds the child's blocks first and then the parent chain's blocks. When rendering, `BlockNode` pops the most-derived override and renders it. `{{ block.super }}` calls `BlockNode.super` (line 71), which re-renders the next block in that stack, so the parent's original content is output at that point.
